graphic_pattern: closed small rectangular/square footprint with handwritten integer 1..33 inside
notes: The integer is the source column number on TAV-02S; do not replace with P-ID during extraction.

graphic_pattern: handwritten dimensions adjacent to the two sides of a numbered footprint, e.g. 40/50
notes: Dimension values and footprint orientation must be transcribed from the native drawing; do not rotate or normalize by family assumption.

graphic_pattern: long double/parallel lines, often forming L/T/straight shapes through the framing grid and without integer 1..33 inside
notes: These graphics shall never generate a column merely because they form a rectangle or cross a grid line.

graphic_pattern: small unnumbered rectangular mark with nearby values such as 20,25,30,50,65,70,120
notes: Absence of a source column integer is a hard negative for the PT column inventory.

graphic_pattern: thin dimension lines with extension ticks/crosses and span values such as 4.70, 5.10, 4.15
notes: Used later for geometry checks only.
Do not infer supports at polygon vertices.

graphic_pattern: handwritten local text or numbers not enclosed by a numbered column footprint
notes: Can become a property only after source-specific interpretation.

graphic_pattern: column candidate must contain a readable source integer in the set 1..33 inside a closed footprint
notes: Shape alone, proximity to beams, grid intersection, or similarity with upper floors is insufficient. Extraction starts with source IDs 1..33 only.
